upstream.revisionPolicy: Each model is admitted only at its listed exact Hub snapshot. Later cards, weights, serving integrations and distilled variants inherit no qualification automatically.

materialChanges: AuK is an open 1.5B speech foundation model family spanning zero-shot and instruction TTS, content editing, acoustic editing, paralinguistic editing, enhancement and source separation through one natural-language instruction interface.
AuK-Flash is a separately published distilled variant whose upstream claim is fast 4-step generation and editing; its latency-quality tradeoff must be evaluated independently from the base model.

The technical report describes semantic conditioning, a jointly trained speech/audio/music VAE and a hybrid rectified-flow Transformer trained across generation and editing task families, making this materially broader than a conventional TTS-only checkpoint.
The selected AuK source snapshot records Day-0 SGLang-Omni serving support. Runtime support text is integration evidence only and is not an SZL serving, latency or stability measurement.

The Hub repositories declare MIT licensing. The published license scopes the Tencent open release to training code, inference code, parameters and weights made publicly available under the license; dataset/input rights and downstream runtime dependencies remain separate review boundaries.

Voice cloning and speaker-conditioned generation create a provenance and consent boundary that must be carried into fixtures, receipts and any later product exposure rather than treated as a generic audio benchmark.
All quality, data-scale, latency, speaker-similarity, intelligibility and editing claims remain UPSTREAM_REPORTED_NOT_SZL_MEASURED until reproduced on exact artifacts and runtime identity.

acceptance: Pin the exact AuK and AuK-Flash Hub revisions recorded by this wave and retain hashes for README, config, LICENSE and each checkpoint/index artifact actually evaluated; later revisions do not inherit evidence.
Do not rehost weights merely for inventory. Preserve Xet or SHA256 identities and upstream provenance for every exercised artifact.
Evaluate AuK and AuK-Flash independently. The four-step Flash claim is not a base-model quality claim and cannot be promoted without matched task-specific evidence.

Use deterministic, non-sensitive fixtures for TTS, content editing, acoustic editing, paralinguistic editing, enhancement and source separation. Emit separate results by task instead of one aggregate PASS.

Voice-cloning or speaker-conditioned fixtures must use explicitly authorized synthetic or consented reference audio with speaker-consent and provenance metadata. Public-figure impersonation and untracked voice identity are outside the evaluation contract.

Measure intelligibility, edit locality, speaker similarity where consent permits, acoustic preservation, separation leakage or artifacts and failure behavior. Upstream metrics remain UPSTREAM_REPORTED_NOT_SZL_MEASURED until reproduced.

Pin SGLang-Omni or any alternative serving runtime by exact revision or immutable container digest and record CUDA/driver, PyTorch and audio-codec dependency identity. Day-0 support text does not establish production compatibility.

Exercise malformed and oversized audio, unsupported sample rates, cancellation, OOM, long input, runtime restart, partial generation or editing failure and rollback or fallback to the incumbent speech path.

Treat generated and edited audio provenance as a first-class receipt boundary: preserve source-audio hash, instruction hash, model/runtime revision and output hash without publishing sensitive raw reference audio.

Keep provider routing, product defaults, public voice-cloning endpoints, model publication, autonomous audio actions and automatic production promotion false until downstream normal controls independently pass.

deduplication.result: New open speech model family with unified generation/editing/separation behavior; existing dataset and generic serving-runtime waves do not qualify its exact model/task/provenance surface.

authorityChain.githubSource: Frontier records exact external source snapshots and the bounded evaluation contract only; no production source owner is modified by intake.
authorityChain.huggingFaceProjection: Tencent Hub repositories remain the upstream artifacts. No SZLHOLDINGS model mirror or Space deployment is authorized by this wave.
authorityChain.productRuntime: No a-11-oy.com speech route, model, voice-cloning endpoint or default changes until Forge, Serve and any required GPU receipts satisfy normal controls.
authorityChain.proofEvidence: a11oy.net may publish only non-sensitive measured receipts, hashes and known bounds. Raw consented reference audio and unsupported upstream metrics must not be promoted as proof.

alignment.claimBoundary: Admission establishes an exact-source speech evaluation target only. It does not establish voice identity rights, data rights, task quality, latency, SGLang-Omni production support, deployment readiness or authorization for voice cloning or audio effectors.
